notes: This bounded contract covers ordinary (non-regional) declaration-management relevance transitions in Umbra's non-installable development profile. The registry compares effective published object-class attributes and active subscriptions across the ordinary class hierarchy, plus published interaction classes and active interaction subscriptions, retains the receiving federate's selected service-report route, and the adapter appends the RTI-initiated advisory report before queuing each of the four official callbacks after releasing runtime locks. Passive subscriptions do not establish relevance. The per-federate Object Class Relevance Advisory Switch and Interaction Relevance Advisory Switch gate callback emission. Regional declaration services, regional DDM, generic MOM interaction delivery, update-rate enforcement, transport, package evidence, protected review, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
